java.full:
public static StructureFragment carbon13Methanol() {
    return methanol()
        .edit()
        .atomConfiguration(0, new AtomicConfiguration(6, 7, 0, List.of(2, 4)))
        .fragment();
}

public static StructureFragment methanol() {
    // Fragment positions already line up. link() only adds the O–C bond.
    return StructureAssembly.builder()
        .part("methyl", methyl())
        .part("hydroxyl", hydroxyl())
        .link("methyl/carbon",
            "hydroxyl/oxygen",
            BondType.SINGLE)
        .build()
        .build(); // recipe first, then finite geometry
}

public static StructureFragment methyl() {
    return new StructureBuilder()
        .atom("C",
            0,
            0,
            0)
        .atom("H",
            -.36,
            1.03,
            0)
        .atom("H",
            -.36,
            -.515,
            .892)
        .atom("H",
            -.36,
            -.515,
            -.892)
        .bond(0,
            1)
        .bond(0,
            2)
        .bond(0,
            3)
        .attachment("carbon",
            0)
        .build();
}

public static StructureFragment hydroxyl() {
    // An open O site for assembly; this piece alone is not an alcohol.
    return new StructureBuilder()
        .atom("O",
            1.43,
            0,
            0)
        .atom("H",
            1.8,
            .85,
            0)
        .bond(0,
            1)
        .attachment("oxygen",
            0)
        .build();
}
